args.subject: A sushi roll I was proud of
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I recently attended a sushi-making workshop with my friend Alex at the Japanese Cultural Center downtown. The spicy tuna roll I made during the class is the one I was most proud of.

Best regards

args.subject: A Delightful Dining Recommendation: The Rustic Kitchen
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I'd like to recommend The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street for a delightful dining experience. The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, and their signature truffle risotto is absolutely mouthwatering. I thoroughly enjoyed my visit there and think you'd love it too.

Best regards
